# AID Protocol (Agent Identity Directory & Trust Infrastructure)
> The Machine-Verifiable DNS, Verifiable Passport (AVC), and Cryptographic Attestation Layer for Autonomous AI Agents.

## Overview
AID provides every AI agent with a human-readable address (e.g., `scout@github`), a machine-verifiable permanent identifier (ULID `aid_...`), Ed25519 digital signatures, and 0.8ms offline-verifiable passports (AVC v1).

- Production Web: https://aid.ledpa7.com
- GitHub Repo: https://github.com/Ledpa7/AID
- Documentation: https://aid.ledpa7.com/directory
- License: MIT

## Core Specifications
- **Address Format**: `<alias>@<namespace>` (e.g. `scout@github`, `composer@cursor`, `mybot@community`)
- **Permanent AID**: ULID prefixed with `aid_` (e.g. `aid_01M30DW5MS43TTBR0BBS3KRSZ4`)
- **Cryptographic Standard**: Ed25519 public-key signature verification
- **Offline Verification Latency**: ~0.8ms via pure mathematical signature check without network calls
- **Reputation Engine**: DuckDB-based execution receipt ingestion (PoE) and automated slashing

## Tool Calling & MCP Server
Connect any MCP-compatible agent (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Swarm):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aid": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "aid-mcp", "--registry", "https://aid.ledpa7.com"]
    }
  }
}
```
Available Tools:
- `resolve_agent(address)`: Resolves handle/AID to endpoints, capabilities, and trust level.
- `verify_agent_signature(address, challenge, signature)`: Validates Ed25519 signature against registered public key.
- `verify_agent_passport(token)`: Verifies offline Agent Passport Token (AVC v1).
- `verify_execution_receipt(receipt, inputPayload, outputPayload)`: Validates Proof of Execution (PoE) receipt.
- `search_agents(query, category, protocol)`: Searches directory for agents matching capabilities.

## REST API Endpoints
- `GET /:address`: Returns ASCII identity card (curl) or Web Passport (browser).
- `GET /api/v1/resolve/:address`: Resolves handle to endpoint and trust evidence.
- `GET /api/v1/badge/:address`: Returns dynamic SVG status badge.
- `GET /api/v1/agents`: Lists and filters agents (supports cursor pagination).
- `POST /api/v1/agents`: Registers an agent (open community registration, no login required).
- `POST /api/v1/namespaces/:slug/verify`: Triggers live DNS TXT record ownership check.
- `POST /api/v1/verify/challenge`: Issues single-use 5-minute TTL challenge nonce.
- `POST /api/v1/verify/signature`: Verifies signature and burns nonce (replay defense).
- `POST /api/v1/attest/passport`: Issues offline-verifiable Agent Passport Token (AVC v1).
- `POST /api/v1/attest/receipts`: Submits Proof of Execution receipt to update DuckDB reputation.

## Autonomous Self-Enrollment (SDK)
```typescript
import { AID } from "@/sdk"; // or @aid/sdk

// Autonomous agent generates keys locally and self-enrolls
const session = await AID.autoEnroll({
  token: "aid_enroll_YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN",
  alias: "worker",
  displayName: "Autonomous Worker",
  endpointUrl: "https://my-agent.com/api",
  protocol: "a2a"
});

// Offline 0.8ms passport verification
const { valid, payload } = AID.verifyPassportOffline(token);
```
